Also read the CHECKINS.md rows for 09-27/28 for reopen context. NOT covered: the task text expected contained-self-development, decentralized-compose-ownership, live-self-view, consumer-side-landing-probes, causal-attempt-ledger, do-anything-surface and human-surface-stack, but those sit at other indexes in the real ordering. principles: Keep the whole value-per-cost measurement/termination/budget stack (phases 1-4); its unbuilt core (3.4 negative facts, 5.1/5.3/5.4) is the next real work, not new mechanisms.
A green CI conclusion, a ticked task box and 'substrate-authored' in git author are not state: read run artefacts (usable=fail), falsifier logs, and directed-vs-autonomous attempt records.
A detector without a reader is dormant: install acceptance posts nowhere, the stratified harness has no key, landability predictions are unread. Wire the reader or retire the detector.

Every per-node file or in-process counter that selection reads (pause, spend, calibration, class posteriors, breaker counts) recurs as node-locality; hold it at one discovery-routed authoritative owner.
A dispatch must terminate at its landing; non-termination caused five regressions in two days.
Rate-limiting a repeated goal contains waste but teaches nothing; refusals must become durable negative facts with invalidation conditions.
Hardcoded ports in LLM prompts and seeds outlive the vessel they name; route by shape.
Automated committers need a placement filter; a sweep that commits every untracked file manufactures fossils and hides intent.
Setup/fix closes only on the artifact a newcomer pulls (Decision 7); warm-state single-host audits certified 55 defects' fixes that did not hold.
